project.name: vizai-camera-integration-gateway

git.note: The Implement directory and its parents are not a Git repository.

currentTask.name: Safe inventory loading and startup composition

completedSubtasks.name: Protect generated and local configuration files
completedSubtasks.evidence: .gitignore excludes dependencies, build/coverage output, environment files, logs, and config/*.local.json

completedSubtasks.name: Implement bounded inventory file loading

completedSubtasks.name: Add focused inventory file-loader tests
completedSubtasks.evidence: test/camera-inventory-file-loader.test.ts has six focused tests; related loader/inventory run passes with 2 files and 13 tests, and pnpm build passes

completedSubtasks.name: Define the safe startup-registration result contract
completedSubtasks.evidence: src/startup/camera-startup-report.ts defines registered/failed results and ready/degraded reports without provider failure details

completedSubtasks.name: Coordinate independent camera registration
completedSubtasks.evidence: src/startup/register-camera-inventory.ts attempts registrations sequentially, continues after failures, and returns safe results

completedSubtasks.name: Add focused startup-registration tests
completedSubtasks.evidence: test/register-camera-inventory.test.ts has three focused tests; related coordinator/gateway run passes with 2 files and 11 tests, and pnpm build passes

completedSubtasks.name: Compose startup from an inventory file
completedSubtasks.evidence: src/startup/start-camera-gateway-from-file.ts validates and loads the complete inventory before delegating registration

completedSubtasks.name: Add focused file-to-gateway startup tests
completedSubtasks.evidence: test/start-camera-gateway-from-file.test.ts covers four intended paths; full Phase 1 build and 14 test files with 78 tests pass
